natural: A clear breeze and a bright moon

meaning.en: A serene, beautiful night; a life of leisure and purity.
meaning.zh: 清凉的风，明亮的月。形容美好的夜景，也比喻清闲无事或品格高洁。

examples.zh: 清风明月，正是赏月的好时候。
examples.en: A clear breeze and bright moon — perfect for moon-gazing.

examples.zh: 他辞官归隐，与清风明月为伴。
examples.en: He resigned and retired, with only the breeze and moon for company.

natural: When the rabbit dies, the fox grieves

meaning.en: To grieve for a fellow sufferer (fearing the same fate); usually of bad people.
meaning.zh: 兔子死了，狐狸感到悲伤。比喻因同类的死亡而感到悲伤（多用于贬义）。

equivalents: there but for the grace of God go I

examples.zh: 同伙被抓，他兔死狐悲，坐立不安。
examples.en: With his accomplice arrested, he feared the same fate and couldn't sit still.

examples.zh: 同行倒闭，大家兔死狐悲。
examples.en: When a competitor went bust, the others felt a chill of fellow feeling.

story.en: A defector was told: "When the fox dies, the rabbit weeps; when the Li clan is destroyed, the Xia clan won't survive either" (狐死兔泣).
story.zh: 《宋史·李全传》："狐死兔泣，李氏灭，夏氏宁独存？"

meaning.en: Stunningly beautiful (of a woman).
meaning.zh: 鱼见了沉入水底，雁见了降落沙洲。形容女子容貌美丽。

equivalents: a face that launched a thousand ships

examples.zh: 西施有沉鱼落雁之容。
examples.en: Xi Shi had a beauty to make fish sink and geese fall.

examples.zh: 她长得沉鱼落雁，闭月羞花。
examples.en: She's breathtakingly beautiful.

story.en: Zhuangzi notes that the famous beauties Mao Qiang and Li Ji are admired by people, yet "fish who see them dive deep, birds who see them fly high" — originally about relative perspectives. Later legends link the phrase to Xi Shi and Wang Zhaojun.
story.zh: 《庄子》："毛嫱丽姬，人之所美也；鱼见之深入，鸟见之高飞。"后传说西施浣纱鱼沉，昭君出塞雁落。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Attributive or predicate. Often with 闭月羞花.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，常与"闭月羞花"连用。

meaning.en: Like-minded (often of bad company).
meaning.zh: 指人的思想作风相同，彼此很合得来（多用于贬义）。

examples.zh: 他们俩气味相投，经常一起喝酒。
examples.en: They're birds of a feather and often drink together.

examples.zh: 这帮人气味相投，结成了小团伙。
examples.en: These like-minded people formed a little gang.

usage.en: Predicate. Often slightly negative (compare 志同道合).

natural: Making the moon hide and flowers blush

meaning.en: Breathtakingly beautiful (of a woman).
meaning.zh: 使月亮躲藏，使花儿羞惭。形容女子容貌美丽。

examples.zh: 她有闭月羞花之貌。
examples.en: She has breathtaking beauty.

examples.zh: 小说中的女主角闭月羞花。
examples.en: The novel's heroine is stunningly beautiful.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate. Later legends link 闭月 to Diaochan and 羞花 to Yang Guifei.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。后世传说"闭月"指貂蝉，"羞花"指杨贵妃。

meaning.en: Better to die with honour than live in disgrace.
meaning.zh: 宁愿做玉器被打碎，不愿做瓦器而保全。比喻宁愿为正义而死，不愿苟且偷生。

equivalents: better to die on your feet than live on your knees

examples.zh: 宁为玉碎，不为瓦全。
examples.en: Better to be shattered jade than an intact tile.

examples.zh: 他宁为玉碎，也不向恶势力低头。
examples.en: He'd rather die with honour than bow to the villains.

story.en: When the Northern Qi usurper ordered the Yuan clan to change their surname, Yuan Jingan agreed, but his cousin Yuan Jinghao said: "A great man would rather be shattered jade than an intact tile" (大丈夫宁可玉碎，不能瓦全).
story.zh: 元景皓说："大丈夫宁可玉碎，不能瓦全。"

usage.en: Usually with 不为瓦全. 宁 is nìng.
usage.zh: 常与"不为瓦全"连用。"宁"读 nìng。

meaning.en: To predict events with uncanny accuracy.
meaning.zh: 预料事情像神仙一样准确。形容预见性强。

examples.zh: 诸葛亮料事如神。
examples.en: Zhuge Liang predicted events with uncanny accuracy.

examples.zh: 他料事如神，早就猜到了结果。
examples.en: He saw it coming — he guessed the result long ago.

synonyms: 运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外

meaning.en: To lose all credibility and authority.
meaning.zh: 威望和信誉完全丧失。

examples.zh: 丑闻曝光后，他在公司威信扫地。
examples.en: After the scandal broke, he lost all credibility at the company.

examples.zh: 言而无信会让领导威信扫地。
examples.en: Breaking promises destroys a leader's authority.

meaning.en: A heroic but impossible quest; also overreaching ambition.
meaning.zh: 比喻人有大志，也比喻不自量力。

examples.zh: 夸父逐日的故事表现了古人征服自然的愿望。
examples.en: The myth of Kuafu chasing the sun shows the ancients' wish to conquer nature.

examples.zh: 这个计划无异于夸父逐日。
examples.en: This plan is a quixotic quest.

story.en: The giant Kuafu raced the sun; thirsty, he drank the Yellow and Wei rivers dry and died of thirst on the way to a great lake. His staff became a peach forest.
story.zh: 夸父与太阳赛跑，口渴喝干了黄河、渭水，北去大泽途中渴死，手杖化为桃林。

date.zh: 战国至汉 · 前4世纪—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Han, 4th–1st c. BC

meaning.en: Never satisfied; always wanting more.
meaning.zh: 已经取得陇右，还想攻取西蜀。比喻贪得无厌。

equivalents: give them an inch and they'll take a mile

examples.zh: 他升了职还不满足，得陇望蜀。
examples.en: Even after his promotion he's not satisfied — he always wants more.

examples.zh: 做人不能得陇望蜀。
examples.en: Don't be insatiable.

story.en: Emperor Guangwu wrote to his general after taking Longxi: "People suffer from not knowing contentment — having pacified Long, I now look towards Shu."
story.zh: 光武帝写信给岑彭："人苦不知足，既平陇，复望蜀。"

natural: Where benefit and harm are at stake

meaning.en: Of vital concern; with much at stake.
meaning.zh: 利害关系密切。

equivalents: a matter of life and death

examples.zh: 这个决定与每个员工利害攸关。
examples.en: This decision is of vital interest to every employee.

examples.zh: 这是一场利害攸关的谈判。
examples.en: It's a high-stakes negotiation.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 攸 is yōu.

meaning.en: To sever all ties of affection and loyalty.
meaning.zh: 恩情和情义完全断绝。多指夫妻或朋友关系破裂。

examples.zh: 两人离婚后恩断义绝，再无来往。
examples.en: After the divorce they cut all ties and never spoke again.

examples.zh: 他背叛了朋友，从此恩断义绝。
examples.en: He betrayed his friend, and that was the end of their friendship.

natural: Scooping the moon out of the water

meaning.en: A futile effort; chasing an illusion.
meaning.zh: 到水中去捞月亮。比喻去做根本做不到的事情，只能白费力气。

examples.zh: 不努力就想成功，无异于水中捞月。
examples.en: Wanting success without effort is chasing rainbows.

examples.zh: 他的计划不切实际，到头来是水中捞月。
examples.en: His plan was unrealistic and came to nothing in the end.

synonyms: 一个是水中月，一个是镜中花

natural: Spring flowers and the autumn moon

meaning.en: The beauties of the seasons; fleeting good times.
meaning.zh: 春天的花，秋天的月。泛指美好的时光或景物。

examples.zh: 春花秋月何时了，往事知多少。
examples.en: Spring flowers and autumn moons — when will they end? How much of the past remains?

examples.zh: 春花秋月，岁岁年年。
examples.en: Spring flowers and autumn moons, year after year.

story.en: The captive last ruler of Southern Tang, Li Yu, wrote: "Spring flowers, autumn moon — when will they end? How much of the past do I remember?" (春花秋月何时了，往事知多少).
story.zh: 李煜《虞美人》："春花秋月何时了，往事知多少。"

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

meaning.en: Brilliant strategy; uncanny foresight.
meaning.zh: 惊人的机智，巧妙的谋划。指高明的策略。

examples.zh: 诸葛亮神机妙算，草船借箭。
examples.en: With masterful strategy, Zhuge Liang 'borrowed' arrows with straw boats.

examples.zh: 多亏你神机妙算，我们才赢了。
examples.en: We won thanks to your brilliant planning.

meaning.en: Fine silks; luxurious fabrics.
meaning.zh: 泛指各种丝织品。也指华贵的衣服。

examples.zh: 店里摆满了各色绫罗绸缎。
examples.en: The shop is full of silks and satins of every colour.

examples.zh: 她穿着绫罗绸缎，像个贵妇人。
examples.en: Dressed in fine silks, she looked like a lady.

usage.en: Noun phrase. A cultural set of four silk types.

natural: The old man under the moon

meaning.en: The god of marriage; a matchmaker.
meaning.zh: 原指传说中主管婚姻的神仙。后泛指媒人。

examples.zh: 他们的婚事是她当的月下老人。
examples.en: She played matchmaker for their marriage.

examples.zh: 感谢月下老人，让我们走到了一起。
examples.en: Thank Cupid for bringing us together.

origin.source: 李复言《续玄怪录·定婚店》

story.en: Wei Gu met an old man reading under the moon, who said he kept the book of marriages and tied the feet of destined couples with red thread.
story.zh: 韦固夜遇一老人在月下翻书，老人说是管天下婚姻的，用红绳系住夫妻的脚。

meaning.en: (Polite) Your visit honours my humble home.
meaning.zh: 使寒门增添光辉。多用作宾客来到家里或得到别人赠送的字画时的客套话。

equivalents: to what do I owe the pleasure

examples.zh: 您能光临寒舍，真是蓬荜生辉。
examples.en: Your visit truly honours my humble home.

examples.zh: 有您的字挂在墙上，我家蓬荜生辉。
examples.en: With your calligraphy on our wall, our home is honoured.

natural: Days and months flying like a shuttle

meaning.en: Time flies.
meaning.zh: 太阳和月亮像织布的梭子一样来回穿梭。形容时间过得很快。

examples.zh: 光阴似箭，日月如梭。
examples.en: Time flies like an arrow; the days and months like a shuttle.

examples.zh: 日月如梭，孩子转眼就长大了。
examples.en: The years fly by — the children have grown up in a flash.

natural: Forcing holes and joining things together

meaning.en: To give far-fetched interpretations.
meaning.zh: 把讲不通的或不相干的道理、事情硬扯在一起进行解释。

examples.zh: 这种解释纯属穿凿附会。
examples.en: That interpretation is completely far-fetched.

examples.zh: 研究历史不能穿凿附会。
examples.en: In history you mustn't read too much into things.

meaning.en: A letter home saying all is well; a New Year blessing.
meaning.zh: 比喻平安家信，也用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 春节贴上"竹报平安"，祝全家平平安安。
examples.en: At New Year people put up "bamboo brings peace" for the family's safety.

examples.zh: 出门在外，他常写信竹报平安。
examples.en: Away from home, he often writes to say all is well.

usage.en: Mostly a blessing or decoration. Firecrackers (爆竹) are part of the pun.

meaning.en: Rude at first, fawning later (when one's status changes).
meaning.zh: 以前傲慢，后来恭敬。形容对人的态度改变。

examples.zh: 他发达后，亲戚们前倨后恭。
examples.en: Once he made it big, his relatives changed their tune completely.

examples.zh: 这种前倨后恭的人，真让人看不起。
examples.en: People who only respect you once you're successful are despicable.

story.en: When Su Qin returned home a failure, his sister-in-law wouldn't cook for him; when he returned as minister of six states, she knelt before him. He asked: "Why were you arrogant before and so humble now?"
story.zh: 苏秦落魄时嫂子不给他做饭，后来他佩六国相印归来，嫂子跪拜。苏秦问："嫂何前倨而后卑也？"

meaning.en: All's fair in war.
meaning.zh: 用兵作战不排斥运用欺诈的手段迷惑敌人。

equivalents: all's fair in love and war

examples.zh: 兵不厌诈，比赛中虚晃一招很正常。
examples.en: All's fair in war — feints are normal in competition.

examples.zh: 商场如战场，兵不厌诈。
examples.en: Business is war, and war is deception.

story.en: Jiu Fan advised Duke Wen of Jin: "A gentleman of ritual never tires of loyalty; but in battle, one never tires of deception" (战阵之间，不厌诈伪).
story.zh: 《韩非子·难一》："繁礼君子，不厌忠信；战阵之间，不厌诈伪。"

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

natural: Fine clothes and a spirited horse

meaning.en: Dashing and lavish; the swagger of privileged youth.
meaning.zh: 穿着华丽的衣服，骑着健壮的马。形容生活豪华，也形容年少意气风发。

examples.zh: 他年少时鲜衣怒马，意气风发。
examples.en: In his youth he was dashing and full of swagger.

examples.zh: 那些鲜衣怒马的富家子弟。
examples.en: Those lavishly dressed rich kids.

meaning.en: Graceful and lissom (of a woman's walk or figure).
meaning.zh: 形容女子走路体态轻盈柔美。

examples.zh: 她袅袅婷婷地走了进来。
examples.en: She glided in gracefully.

examples.zh: 舞台上的舞者袅袅婷婷。
examples.en: The dancers on stage were graceful and lissom.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. An idiomatic AABB.
